body.p: Why the moss is read. There lived a woman in some land. She had four children. They did not help their mother, they did not listen to their mother. The mother worked in the house by herself. Once the [ShA:] With the interpretation of Ð¼Ð¾Ð·ÑÐ°ÑÑÐ±Ð¸ I am not completely sure.mother went fishing. The mother wandered in the water, got her feet wet and fell ill. The mother became thirsty and said to the elder child: "Bring me water." "Take it yourself", âthe child said. She said to another child: "Bring me water." He also did not want to bring her water. The two younger children didn't want to either. They went to play. Their mother stood up, took to scrapers, took a thimble, took a scythe, took a comb. She became a cuckoo. The thimble became her nose, the scrapers became her wings, the scythe became her back, the comb became her tail.[ShA:] Presumably, different variants of the pronunciation of scraper-DU in the neigbouring sentences are an artefact of The children just entered the tent, as she flew away through the source, but I cannot change this without access to the recording.the flue. She said: "Cuckoo, cuckoo, there is a lot of marsh water in front of me." The children jumped crying, they carry water in a ladle: "Mummy, here's your water." The cuckoo said: "I don't want water, there is a lot of water in front of me." She flew away. The children ran after her for a long time. They run barefoot. Their feet became bloody. Their legs' blood that dripped and fell onto the ground became the moss. After that bloody moss appeared. There is a lot such red moss on the ground. This is the blood of her children.
